problem: Solve the equation $\operatorname{tan}⁡x=15$ for ${0}^{∘}\le x<{360}^{∘},$ rounded to the nearest integer.
worked_solution:
First, we find the principal value:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\operatorname{arctan}⁡(15)=86.185\,925{…}^{∘}≈{86.19}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

Since ${86.19}^{∘}$ lies inside the given domain, our first solution is ${x}_{1}={86.19}^{∘}.$

To generate more solutions, we add integer multiples of ${180}^{∘}.$ Hence,

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}={180}^{∘}+{86.19}^{∘}={266.19}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the solutions are

$$
x={86}^{∘},{266}^{∘}
$$

rounded to the nearest integer.
